name: mylang2-support-language
description: Language support for MyLang2: language server with diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, rename, semantic highlighting and more.
author: Sempai<zadmanthegreat@gmail.com>

mylang.compiler.path.markdownDescription: Path to the MyLang2 compiler package (folder with `package.json`, or its `dist/src/index.js`). Used for exact syntax errors. When empty the server looks in `<workspace>/dist`, `<workspace>/node_modules/mylang2` and next to the extension. Without a compiler a built-in checker is used.

mylang.executable.description: Command used by “Run Current File” and the formatting commands.

mylang.run.noColors.markdownDescription: Pass `--no-colors` to every command this extension runs, so the terminal gets plain text (MyLang2 2.3 and later). The switch also applies to what the program itself prints.

mylang.diagnostics.unresolved.description: Severity of references to names that are not defined.

mylang.diagnostics.unknownMembers.description: Severity of unknown members of built-in modules (e.g. strings.splitt).

mylang.diagnostics.unknownModules.description: Severity of imports of unknown module names.

mylang.diagnostics.deprecated.markdownDescription: Severity of uses of APIs marked `@deprecated`.

mylang.diagnostics.unused.description: How unused variables and imports are reported.

mylang.diagnostics.maxProblems.description: Maximum number of problems reported per file.

mylang.completion.autoImport.description: Offer built-in modules that are not imported yet and add the import automatically.

mylang.completion.coreNamespace.markdownDescription: Write imports of built-in modules through the `core:` namespace (`import "core:fs"`). The namespaced form cannot be shadowed by a project dependency. Turn this off to insert the bare name (`import "fs"`).

mylang.format.enable.markdownDescription: Format `.ml` files with the language's own formatter (`mylang prettier`, MyLang2 2.3 and later), so the editor and the command line always agree. The formatter is found the same way as the compiler; see `mylang.compiler.path`.

mylang.format.configFile.markdownDescription: Read formatter settings from this file instead of the nearest `mylang.json` (the equivalent of `mylang prettier --config <file>`).

mylang.format.options.markdownDescription: Formatter settings that win over the project's `mylang.json`, the way a flag beats the file on the command line. Leave empty to use the project's settings.

useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

printWidth.description: Break longer lines at the commas of a bracket that closes on them; 0 never breaks.

quote.markdownDescription: The quote plain strings are written with. `"""…"""` and `$"…"` strings are never touched.

maxBlankLines.description: Keep at most this many empty lines in a row.

finalNewline.description: End a non-empty file with exactly one line break.

mylang.globals.description: Extra global names (e.g. defined by `initScript` in mylang.json) that must not be reported as undefined.

mylang.trace.server.description: Trace the communication with the language server.
